text:
mina: quick thought  current evals "Approve" is overloaded. proposing two clear CTAs: 'Pass' for quick triage and 'Sign & Archive' for permanent sign-off (creates audit).

leo: are we aiming to reduce accidental archives or to make audits more discoverable?

mina: both. customers accidentally created audits during fast triage. 'Pass' signals non-permanent intent.

kai: backend ok to emit an event for Sign & Archive. recommend event name evals.signoff.v2. payload example in PR: `{user_id, mode: "pass"|"archive", prompt_set_sha, count, audit_id?, archive_url?}`. snapshot only on archive.

rachel: a11y note: two CTAs need clear grouping and descriptions. use role="group" with aria-labelledby and visible microcopy. add an sr-only paragraph that explains differences and link it via aria-describedby on each button. confirmation dialog must be alertdialog with focus trap.

noah: in interviews people liked short verbs. "Pass" felt safer than "Approve" for quick work. They also wanted a small preview before archive.

mina: mock: compact split button, primary = Pass, secondary = Sign & Archive (opens confirm sheet). visible help text: "Pass: fast triage. Sign & Archive: snapshot stored and audit id created."

leo: copy tweak: shorten secondary to "Sign + Archive" in the toolbar, full label in the confirm sheet.

rachel: tooltip alone is not accessible. ensure consequence text is visible and keyboard-focusable. when archive completes, announce: "Archived X items. Audit ID: ABC123" via aria-live and focus the result panel. toast must be keyboard-dismissable.

kai: shortcut plan: Mod+Enter = Pass, Mod+Shift+Enter = Sign + Archive. frontend emits `trigger: ui|shortcut` in telemetry. for bulk >200 items use archive_url to avoid huge snapshots.

noah: usability plan: show shortcut hint under primary on first run (dismissible). run 6 sessions including 2 SR users. track accidental archives and preview open rate.

mina: QA checklist: group role/label, aria-describedby targets, alertdialog semantics, keyboard shortcuts, preview accessible, toast shows audit id and link, bulk summary not full dump, contrast tokens.

build-bot: Created issue #6312: "evals: pass vs sign+archive CTA + a11y" and assigned to kai.

leo: decision: proceed with Pass / Sign + Archive behind org flag. include preview, shortcuts, and a11y checklist. beta to compliance orgs first.

mina: actions: @kai open schema PR, @rachel add a11y checklist to PR template, @noah schedule sessions. I'll update figma and post link when branch is ready.

kai: starting branch tomorrow.

rachel: will PR checklist.

mina: thanks all :thumbsup:
